text: The accepted QR requestAuthorizationToIncludePasswords method is async but its comment still declares a boolean return. The caller awaits it and aborts export on false; the wizard initializer documents Promise<void>. Scoped documentation recommendation: describe Promise<boolean> and what refusal does for this authorization helper. The comment is not proof of a synchronous return or a project-wide JSDoc mandate.
